steps.text: Bring a shovel and a rope.
South of Northport, dig open the hole with your shovel and go down: the start of the route to Demona.
steps.source: Follow the directions to go to Demona using the stardard route.

steps.text: Follow the route to Demona through the Maze of Lost Souls and go up the stairs into Demona.
steps.source: Follow the directions to go to Demona using the stardard route.

steps.text: Past the warlocks and elf arcanists, take the north-west stairs of the star room (the way to the exit teleport).
steps.source: When you are in Demona you will find several Warlocks and Elf Arcanists, take the North-West Ladder of the Star Room, the one that is leading to the exit Teleport.

steps.text: Follow the path and take the first way north to the room full of bookcases: the purple tome is in the bookcase on the west wall.
steps.source: Now Continue along the path and take the first way north until you reach this point. In this room, there are a lot of bookcases. In those bookcases you will find the Maps and the tome.

steps.text: A map in a bookcase on the north wall.
steps.source: In those bookcases you will find the Maps and the tome.

steps.text: Another map further east on the north wall.
steps.source: In those bookcases you will find the Maps and the tome.
